# AGC test data

`toy_ex.agc.b64` is a base64 encoding of the upstream AGC `toy_ex.agc` test
archive, reused through the `github.com/martinghunt/go-agc` project. The
[upstream AGC project](https://github.com/refresh-bio/agc) is distributed under
the MIT License, Copyright (c) 2021 REFRESH Bioinformatics Group.
